title: Size of Change and the Restart Change Order Fee — Professional Services Projects
content:
The size of a restart change order on a Professional Services Projects engagement sets how its administration fee is built.

## Clause

For the size of the change, the administration fee of a restart change order adds nothing to the class administration fee when the absolute value change is below the class waiver figure; when it is the waiver figure or more, 2.5 percent of the part of the absolute value change above the waiver figure is added to the class administration fee; when it is 4 times the waiver figure or more, a change review of 2 hours at the class solutions architect rate is added as well, so that a larger change never carries a smaller fee. The value change read is that of the restart change order as signed, taken as an absolute amount.

| Absolute value change | Administration fee |
|---|---|
| below the class waiver figure | the class administration fee, nothing added |
| the waiver figure or more, below 4 times it | the class administration fee plus 2.5 percent of the part above the waiver figure |
| 4 times the waiver figure or more | the class administration fee plus 2.5 percent of the part above the waiver figure plus 2 hours at the class solutions architect rate |

## Class figures

| Engagement class | Administration fee | Waiver figure | 4 times the waiver figure | Solutions architect rate | Change review (2 hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Assessment Engagement | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 245.00 | 490.00 |
| Quick Start Project | 95.00 | 500.00 | 2000.00 | 245.00 | 490.00 |
| Standard Project | 150.00 | 1000.00 | 4000.00 | 240.00 | 480.00 |
| Advanced Project | 250.00 | 2500.00 | 10000.00 | 230.00 | 460.00 |
| Major Project | 350.00 | 5000.00 | 20000.00 | 220.00 | 440.00 |
| Strategic Program | 500.00 | 10000.00 | 40000.00 | 210.00 | 420.00 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical value changes, Major Project)

- 3000.00: below 5000.00, so 350.00.
- 8000.00: 350.00 plus 2.5 percent of 3000.00, that is 75.00, giving 425.00.
- 26000.00: 350.00 plus 2.5 percent of 21000.00, that is 525.00, plus the 440.00 change review, giving 1315.00.
